//: THE FEATURE LEDGER SPINE. This is the ONLY hand-authored input to
`node scripts/gen-feature-ledger.mjs`. Every other column in the generated
ledger is JOINED from something already measured in this repo — never typed
in here, and never invented.
WHAT MAY LIVE IN THIS FILE: the name of a feature, the paths it occupies,
the setting that gates it, and the website page that documents it. All four
are CHECKABLE, and the generator checks them: a `paths` entry that matches no
file on disk is a hard failure, and so is a `doc` naming a page that does not
exist. Staleness is enforced in both directions, like every other baseline in
this repo.
WHAT MAY NOT LIVE IN THIS FILE: a score, a grade, a priority, a target, a
review date, or an owner. `scripts/baseline-review-schedule.json` records what
happened the last time an agent put dates in a file like this one — a
fortnightly stagger invented out of nothing and stamped `owner: maintainer`,
which recorded a guess as somebody else's commitment. The judged half of the
ledger lives in prose, written by a human, citing the measured cells. Do not
move it in here because a column would be tidier.
`flag` is the setting key that gates the feature, with the DEFAULT as shipped;
`null` means always on. `flagDefault` is verified against
src/stores/settingsStore/defaults.ts by the generator where the key resolves.
GRANULARITY RULE: a row is a thing a user would name. Infrastructure
(plugins/shared, plugins/actions, services/assembly, command_registry.rs) is
deliberately absent — it has no user-facing surface to strengthen, and giving
it a row would dilute every ranking the ledger produces.
COMPANION: `.claude/feature-ledger.md` is the hand-inspected, qualitative
ledger (what each feature does, how it is reached and gated, what is unwired
or stale). The generated table cites the same feature NAMES used here, so
renaming a row here is a rename there too. `flagDefault` is now VERIFIED
against `src/stores/settingsStore/defaults.ts` at generation time — a value
that drifts refuses to generate (2026-09-07: `browser.enabled` had said false
for three weeks after the shipped default became true).

features.name: Info boxes, collapsible sections & inline TOC

infrastructure.//: Shared plumbing with no user-facing surface of its own (the GRANULARITY RULE above). Declared, not inferred: a file here was looked at and judged infrastructure, while a file nowhere fails scripts/check-feature-map.mjs. Move a path to a feature the moment it gains a user-facing role.
